sources.title: Title of the card's dock.
sources.sections: Names of the row groups: impact factors (club), launch (ball, flight model) and flight (carry, total, apex, side).
sources.blank_text: Value of a number the exporter did not compute (never shown as 0).
sources.flight_unavailable_text: Start of the Ball Flight row when the flight model gave no flight (e.g. no upstream_physics wheel); the exporter's reason follows. No contact shows the exporter's flight_tracer.NO_CONTACT_STATUS.
sources.needs_bundle_text: Status of a run that is not a same-input bundle: the exporter needs a bundle's club and ball.
sources.default_club: Club label of the flight and roll models when the bundle names no club (the exporter's --club default).
sources.club_labels: Bundle club name -> launch-monitor label of the flight and roll models (club_to_skill reads 7-Iron, not iron7); pass the same --club to compare with the exporter.
sources.angle_decimals: Decimals of the angle rows (as the impact factors panel).
sources.spin_decimals: Decimals of the spin rate (as the flight HUD).
sources.side_left_text: Suffix of a side offset or spin axis to the left.
sources.side_right_text: Suffix of a side offset or spin axis to the right (+).
sources.min_width_px: Smallest card width, so the longest value is not cut.
